description: Unmarked Su-7 at the station war memorial (Flt Lt P V Apte memorial), formerly desert camo now silver (WBI 2024).
Unmarked Marut at the Uttarlai war memorial (WBI 2024).
MiG-21M in the residential area / sports complex north of the railway line (WBI 2024; Bharat Rakshak).
MiG-21 Bison displayed south of the complex near the war memorial (WBI 2024).
MiG-21M on an elaborate platform in front of a building (WBI 2024; Bharat Rakshak).
MiG-21M displayed with the trainer in front of the ATC building, gear down (WBI 2024). Bharat Rakshak lists C-1676 at the ATC display; serial reading differs.
MiG-21U two-seater in front of the ATC building (WBI 2024; Bharat Rakshak).
